briefdescription.para: Translate an ASN.1 OID into its numeric representation (e.g. "\x2A\x86\x48\x86\xF7\x0D" into "1.2.840.113549")

simplesect.para: Length of the string written (excluding final NULL) or PSA_ERROR_BUFFER_TOO_SMALL in case of error

briefdescription.para: Translate a string containing a dotted-decimal representation of an ASN.1 OID into its encoded form (e.g. "1.2.840.113549" into "\x2A\x86\x48\x86\xF7\x0D"). On success, this function allocates oid->buf from the heap. It must be freed by the caller using mbedtls_free().

parameterdescription.para: mbedtls_asn1_buf to populate with the DER-encoded OID
string representation of the OID to parse
length of the OID string, not including any null terminator

simplesect.para: MBEDTLS_ERR_ASN1_INVALID_DATA if oid_str does not represent a valid OID
MBEDTLS_ERR_ASN1_ALLOC_FAILED if the function fails to allocate oid->buf
